description.p: Document Studio is an offline, privacy-first PDF workspace for Linux. Files are opened and processed on your computer. There is no account, no advertisements, and no cloud upload of your documents for viewing, editing, OCR, signing, or conversion.

Use it to view and search PDFs, organize pages (merge, split, rotate, reorder), add markup and links, fill and sign forms, compress files, and run on-device OCR when language data is available. Passwords and signature credentials stay on the device.

This Flatpak build includes desktop engines such as qpdf, Tesseract, and LibreOffice for local compression, OCR, and office-to-PDF conversion on your machine. Optional OCR language packs may be downloaded at your request; that downloads model files only and does not upload the document you are working on.
